answer: Reaching eligibility takes 52 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. The thread register is checked at draw time, nebula lists the eligible set, and sable seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 52 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 372 account operation therefore ties up 4 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
